decoder: original DinoStudent four-depth Fusion; no DetailSkip

checkpoint.selection: Fixed formal Phase4 Baseline_Fusion, reused in Phase5

code_version: Source file SHA256; project has no Git repository

preprocessing.crop: Exact existing rgb_view_rule.screen followed by left_view_rule.candidate; RGB only; no GT or score; same rule for every dataset
preprocessing.resize: aspect preserving, round dimensions, Pillow BILINEAR
preprocessing.restore: remove padding; torch bilinear align_corners=False to cropped native size; paste to full native canvas with outside logits=-30

metrics.IoU: per-image intersection/union, no smoothing; positive mean
metrics.area_strata: native GT/full native image: small <0.05, medium [0.05,0.20), large >=0.20

cases: Top 5 and bottom 5 by Dice, ties lexicographic ID; plus all severe and empty cases

internal_reference.scope: internal development validation, never external average

note: Sanitized metadata export; original code hashes refer to pre-publication source, not the adapted CLI.
